Protocol atlas

Published strategies you can adapt

Protocols are transferable experimental or computational approaches, not simply papers that happen to use metabolomics. Each page maps the scientific concept, workflow stages, tools, and reusable resources.

2 protocols

Metal-binding compound discovery

Native MS metabolomics for metal-binding compounds

2022

A transferable LC-MS strategy that combines post-column pH adjustment and metal infusion with ion identity molecular networking to discover small molecules that bind metals in complex biological samples.

Uses: MZmine · GNPS · MassIVE · Cytoscape

Reverse metabolomics

Reverse metabolomics

2024

A discovery strategy that starts from a candidate chemical structure or reference MS/MS spectrum, searches public metabolomics repositories for matching spectra, and uses sample metadata to reveal biological or phenotypic associations.

Uses: MSMS-Chooser · MASST · ReDU · GNPS
